Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator instructed WebSurfer to use MacroTrends to find when Apple first exceeded $50 “without adjusting for stock splits,” even though the MacroTrends page explicitly shows split-adjusted data and the user asked for the result “according to Google Finance.” This early misdirection (away from Google Finance and toward an adjusted-data source) made the task infeasible, led to looping without extracting the correct unadjusted milestone, and ultimately resulted in the unsupported final answer “2007.”
